sections.heading: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: This Regression Test Report confirms that defect fixes applied during system and UAT cycles did not break existing features. Regression testing was performed after builds v1.0.0-build3 through v1.0.0-build6.

sections.heading: 2. Regression Scope
bullets: Dashboard daily goal rings (steps, calories, workouts)
Admin platform stats and member detail

rows: Upload avatar → visible on profile and dashboard
Existing login/session still works after avatar fix
Simulate walk adds steps without device sensors
Manual step sync API still accepts POST
Train timer and Stats filters still functional
Admin member card shows daily targets and progress
Fresh database seed and migration succeeds

sections.heading: 5. Automated Regression
paragraphs: No regressions detected in automated suite.

sections.heading: 6. New Defects Found During Regression
paragraphs: No new defects were introduced by the fix builds. All 10 regression test cases passed.

sections.heading: 7. Conclusion
paragraphs: Regression testing completed successfully. All previously working features remain functional after defect fixes.
Recommendation: Release build v1.0.0-build6 for final delivery.
